agropelter: A shaggy monkey-like creature with a compact furry brown-grey body, a small ape face with round staring eyes and a wide howling open mouth, seated upright - and ENORMOUSLY LONG THIN ROPY HAIRLESS ARMS many times the length of its body, snaking and coiling through the air like whips, each ending in a small three-fingered hand. The arms are the dominant feature, long and sinuous and looping
amikuk: A strange four-armed sea creature with SLICK DARK GREY-GREEN AMPHIBIAN SKIN like a salamander - not flayed, not raw muscle, not human. FOUR LONG POWERFUL ARMS, and below them the body narrows into ONE SMOOTH TAPERING EEL TAIL with NO legs and NO hips. Its head is a SMOOTH BLANK DOME with no eyes, no nose and no mouth. Shown swimming horizontally, arms sweeping back. An animal, not a person. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
asanbosam: A powerful ape-like creature with A HEAVY MUSCULAR GORILLA BUILD and thick grey-black hide, HANGING UPSIDE DOWN FROM A THICK BRANCH, gripping the branch with its legs, which end in CURVED IRON HOOKS OF DARK FORGED METAL instead of feet. Its VERY LONG POWERFUL ARMS hang straight down toward the viewer with huge clawed hands spread wide. A broad ape face with glowing red eyes and a wide fanged mouth
baize: A bai ze: a noble PALE WHITE lion-like beast with a LONG FLOWING SILVER-WHITE MANE, a leonine face with a calm wise expression, TWO LARGE CURVED RAM-LIKE HORNS sweeping back from its head, and MANY EXTRA EYES - eyes set along its flanks, eyes on its shoulders, and eyes on the tips of slender tendrils rising from its mane - ornate swirling patterns in its fur, long tufted tail, seated upright and serene. It has an animal face, NOT a human face and NO beard
bultungin: A figure SPLIT EXACTLY DOWN THE VERTICAL MIDLINE into two different halves. THE LEFT HALF IS AN ORDINARY HUMAN MAN: human skin, a human eye, half a human face, a human arm and hand, a blacksmith's apron. THE RIGHT HALF IS A SPOTTED HYENA: coarse spotted fur, a hyena eye, half a hyena muzzle, a furred foreleg ending in a clawed paw. The dividing line runs straight down the centre of the face and body. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
camahueto: A young bull, heavy-shouldered and shaggy with coarse dark hide, four hooves, a cow-like head with small ears, and EXACTLY ONE SINGLE VERY LONG STRAIGHT HORN projecting forward and slightly upward from the centre of its forehead - one horn only, no second horn, no side horns, nothing else on its head. Wet earth and torn roots clinging to its flanks and legs, drawn naturalistically like a real bovine
centaur: A centaur. A horse's body with four legs, and WHERE THE HORSE'S NECK AND HEAD WOULD BE THERE IS INSTEAD THE BARE TORSO OF A MUSCULAR BEARDED MAN rising up from the horse's shoulders. THERE IS NO HORSE HEAD ANYWHERE IN THE IMAGE and NO RIDER SITTING ON THE BACK - the human torso replaces the horse's neck entirely and the join is seamless. Chestnut horse coat, tanned human skin, carrying a bow, walking
chullachaqui: A man in a simple smock SEEN FROM BEHIND AND WALKING AWAY FROM THE VIEWER. One of his feet is a cloven deer hoof. THE OTHER FOOT IS REVERSED, so although his back is turned YOU SEE THE TOP OF THAT FOOT AND ITS FIVE TOES POINTING BACK TOWARD THE VIEWER. He glances over his shoulder with a fixed smile. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
curupira: A small boy-sized forest guardian with BRIGHT FLAME-RED HAIR and green-brown skin, SEEN FROM BEHIND AND WALKING AWAY FROM THE VIEWER, his back turned. Because his feet are attached the wrong way round, YOU CAN SEE THE TOPS OF BOTH HIS FEET AND ALL TEN OF HIS TOES POINTING BACK TOWARD THE VIEWER even though his body faces away. Heels forward, toes aimed at the camera. Holding a length of vine. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
douen: The spirit of a small child in a plain smock and A WIDE STRAW HAT, SEEN FROM BEHIND AND WALKING AWAY FROM THE VIEWER. Because its feet are attached the wrong way round, YOU CAN SEE THE TOPS OF BOTH BARE FEET AND ALL THE TOES POINTING BACK TOWARD THE VIEWER while the child walks away. It turns its head, and the face under the hat brim is COMPLETELY BLANK - no eyes, no nose, no mouth. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
dullahan: A HEADLESS rider standing beside a black horse. His neck is a clean empty stump with NOTHING attached to it and NOTHING growing out of it. In his RIGHT hand he holds up HIS OWN SEVERED HUMAN HEAD - pale mouldy skin, a huge grin ear to ear, darting eyes. In his LEFT hand he holds a WHIP MADE OF A HUMAN SPINE, and that spine is held ONLY in the hand and is connected to nothing else. Dark riding clothes
jorogumo: A creature that is A WOMAN FROM THE WAIST UP AND A SPIDER FROM THE WAIST DOWN. Her human torso in a patterned kimono rises directly out of the FRONT OF A LARGE BULBOUS SPIDER ABDOMEN banded in bright yellow and black, which sits low and BEHIND AND BELOW HER WAIST like the body of a centaur. EIGHT BANDED SPIDER LEGS come out of that abdomen at ground level and splay outward. The spider body is beneath her, not above her. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
kamapuaa: An enormous black boar with AN UNNATURALLY LONG STRETCHED BODY, elongated like a dachshund so there is room along its belly for FOUR PAIRS OF LEGS spaced evenly from shoulder to hip - eight boar legs in total, each with a cloven hoof, arranged like a caterpillar's. Shown in FULL SIDE PROFILE so every leg can be counted. On its face, FOUR EYES STACKED IN A VERTICAL COLUMN from jaw to brow. Bristled black coat, upcurved tusks. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
lusca: A COLOSSAL octopus, dark rust-brown and grey mottled, with A NORMAL OCTOPUS HEAD AND TWO ORDINARY OCTOPUS EYES set low on the sides of its huge bulbous mantle. Eight immense thick muscular arms, heavy as tree trunks, coiling and rising out of black water with rows of pale suckers showing. Ancient, scarred and menacing, filling the frame with its sheer size. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
nasnas: HALF OF A MAN, sawn lengthwise down the middle and standing upright, exactly like one half of a shop mannequin cut in two. Shown at a THREE-QUARTER ANGLE so that THE FLAT CUT SURFACE IS CLEARLY VISIBLE as a smooth vertical plane running from the crown of the head to the ground - you can see the flat face of the cut. He has ONE arm in total, ONE leg in total, and half a head with one eye. Hopping. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
soucouyant: An old woman rising into the air, HER HEAD AND SHOULDERS ENGULFED IN A BALL OF ORANGE FLAME so the face is hidden, her body still wearing A LOOSE FADED COTTON SHIFT DRESS. OVER ONE FOREARM SHE CARRIES AN EMPTY LIMP HUMAN SKIN, hanging like a discarded coat with slack empty hands and a loose empty face. Only her bare forearms and shins show, and they are ordinary skin. Eerie rather than gory. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
tiyanak: A small pale infant lying in dark undergrowth with both arms raised to be picked up, with THE PROPORTIONS OF A REAL BABY. It is genuinely unsettling rather than comic: waxy grey-pale skin, EYES ENTIRELY BLACK WITH NO WHITES, a mouth open slightly too wide showing A RING OF FINE NEEDLE TEETH, and a fixed unblinking stare. Quiet and wrong, not laughing, not cartoonish. Isolated figure on a plain empty background with nothing behind it
